name: Shinobu
source:
Meticulous.
She nags her son, Kenichi, because she wants him to grow up properly.
She turns into a sloppy woman whenever she meets her ex-husband, Naoki.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/1214732/]Getchu[/url]]
